However, Disney has a major Thanksgiving-week theatrical release (Zootopia 2, slated for this period), which combined with its already-rising trend (14.1â20.34 over 10 weeks) suggests a further share increase. Tesla has no major catalyst beyond routine software updates â likely reverts toward its recent ~9.3-9.8 baseline rather than another spike. Netflix typically sees modest holiday-week upticks from binge-watching but this is likely outweighed by Black Friday shopping and Disney's movie buzz, so a slight dip is plausible.

**Pre-mortem**: Most likely failure mode is underestimating the Black Friday phone-shopping surge (iPhone/Samsung spike higher than expected) or underestimating Disney's movie-driven surge, either of which could push other shares down more than modeled. I widen sds accordingly, especially for iPhone and Disney.

**Calibration**: Historical week-to-week moves range ~1-9 points for Tesla, ~2-5 for iPhone, ~1-2 for Samsung, ~1-2 for Netflix, ~1-2 for Disney, but Tesla had one 9-point spike and Disney has trended with building momentum â so slightly wider sds are warranted for the holiday-week forecast.
